title: Gym HPV Scares and the Rolls-Royce Rebound
titleZh: 健身房HPV与劳斯莱斯反弹
description: Steven talks about hygiene in Chinese gyms and an alarmist headline about catching HPV at the gym, then explains Rolls-Royce's sharp drop and technical rebound, call options, and why his broker wouldn't let him trade it. He also covers the Getty quote that inspired his AI-built video editor, his plan to split the podcast into several brands, and the one-year deadline he has set to make it pay off.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Content overview

sentences.zh: 今天这期节目，史蒂文先聊了中国健身房的卫生问题，以及一条可能吓跑健身爱好者的新闻：在健身房感染HPV。
sentences.en: In today's episode, Steven first talks about hygiene problems in Chinese gyms, plus a news story that might scare off fitness fans: catching HPV at the gym.

sentences.zh: 接着，他回到上周五暴跌的劳斯莱斯，讲了技术性反弹和看涨期权，还说明了自己为什么在加拿大下不了单。
sentences.en: Next, he returns to Rolls-Royce, which plunged last Friday, talks about technical rebounds and call options, and explains why he can't place an order in Canada.

sentences.zh: 之后，他谈到一句触动他的盖蒂名言、自己用AI搭建的视频控制面板，以及把播客拆成多个“品牌”的计划，并给自己定下一年期限。
sentences.en: After that, he talks about a Getty quote that struck a chord with him, a video control panel he built with AI, and his plan to split the podcast into multiple "brands," giving himself a one-year deadline.

sentences.zh: 中国健身房的卫生
sentences.en: Hygiene in Chinese Gyms

sentences.zh: 如果你是在中国生活的外国人，大概都见过清洁工作做到一半，心想：“这真的有用吗？”
sentences.en: If you're a foreigner living in China, you've probably seen cleaning done halfway and thought, "Does this actually do anything?"

sentences.zh: 史蒂文认识的人几乎都说中国的游泳池有点恶心。
sentences.en: Almost everyone Steven knows says China's swimming pools are a bit gross.

sentences.zh: 不过公平地讲，中国绝不是全世界最糟糕的。
sentences.en: But to be fair, China is by no means the worst in the world.

sentences.zh: 他的检验方法是“闻一闻”：拖把桶里有没有漂白水、肥皂或柠檬味清洁剂的气味？
sentences.en: His test is the "sniff test": does the mop bucket smell of bleach, soap, or lemon-scented cleaner?

sentences.zh: 他健身房里的消毒液，从来闻不出能打扫干净什么。
sentences.en: The disinfectant at his gym never smells like it could clean anything.

sentences.zh: 直到最近两周，健身房才摆出湿巾。
sentences.en: Only in the last two weeks has the gym started putting out wet wipes.

sentences.zh: HPV新闻
sentences.en: HPV News

sentences.zh: 有些人本来就担心在马桶圈上染上HPV，现在又冒出“健身房感染”的标题。
sentences.en: Some people already worry about catching HPV from toilet seats, and now headlines about "gym infections" are popping up too.

sentences.zh: 想让大家更健康，这标题实在糟糕。
sentences.en: If the goal is to make people healthier, this headline is really terrible.

sentences.zh: 新闻说，一名28岁男子健身后用没洗的手抓脸，脸上长出了小肉粒。
sentences.en: According to the news, a 28-year-old man touched his face with unwashed hands after working out, and small bumps grew on his face.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文的反应是：“第一，废话；第二，对，我们知道；第三，那到底打算怎么办？”
sentences.en: Steven's reaction was: "First, duh; second, yes, we know; third, so what are we actually supposed to do about it?"

sentences.zh: 海南省人民医院的医生说，低危型HPV可引起疣，传染性软疣和体癣也能通过接触传播。
sentences.en: A doctor at Hainan Provincial People's Hospital said that low-risk HPV can cause warts, and that molluscum contagiosum and ringworm can also spread through contact.

sentences.zh: 擦干净，洗洗手
sentences.en: Wipe things down and wash your hands

sentences.zh: 时机真不巧。
sentences.en: The timing couldn't be worse.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文正想劝女朋友多练力量，这种新闻会把她和他的学生都吓退。
sentences.en: Steven was just trying to persuade his girlfriend to do more strength training, and news like this will scare off both her and his students.

sentences.zh: 所以：器械要消毒，随身带免洗洗手液，别摸眼睛，旧的健身衣该换就换。
sentences.en: So: disinfect the equipment, carry hand sanitizer with you, don't touch your eyes, and replace old workout clothes when it's time.

sentences.zh: 放在北美，他会把这类新闻当成药企的营销手段。
sentences.en: If this were North America, he'd treat news like this as a pharmaceutical company marketing ploy.

sentences.zh: 报道本身也承认风险极低。
sentences.en: The report itself admits the risk is extremely low.

sentences.zh: 结论是：“洗手，去健身，吃你的西兰花，别怕举铁。”
sentences.en: The bottom line: "Wash your hands, go to the gym, eat your broccoli, and don't be afraid of lifting weights."

sentences.zh: 劳斯莱斯：暴跌与反弹
sentences.en: Rolls-Royce: A Plunge and a Rebound

sentences.zh: 周五，一位听众朋友发来消息：“你看盘了吗？”
sentences.en: On Friday, a listener sent a message: "Have you seen the market?"

sentences.zh: 他没看，因为他早就不整天盯盘了。
sentences.en: He hadn't, because he stopped watching the market all day long ago.

sentences.zh: 劳斯莱斯股价跌了约6%到7%，按美元算大约从1265跌到1164。
sentences.en: Rolls-Royce shares fell about 6% to 7%, roughly from 1265 to 1164 in dollar terms.

sentences.zh: 今天下午5点16分录音时，它已经反弹了约1.8%。
sentences.en: By the time of recording at 5:16 this afternoon, it had already rebounded about 1.8%.

sentences.zh: 老规矩：这不是投资建议。
sentences.en: Usual rule: this is not investment advice.

sentences.zh: 这样的下跌可能继续，也可能只是大资金在圣诞前落袋为安。
sentences.en: A drop like this could continue, or it could just be big money taking profits before Christmas.

sentences.zh: 技术性反弹：大卖家一出手，止损单被全部触发。
sentences.en: A technical rebound: as soon as a big seller moved, all the stop-loss orders were triggered.

sentences.zh: 随后多项指标都显示超卖，机器说一声“该买了”，价格就弹了起来。
sentences.en: Then several indicators all showed it was oversold, the machines said "time to buy," and the price bounced back up.

sentences.zh: 市值是个虚构的数字。
sentences.en: Market value is a made-up number.

sentences.zh: 一家万亿美元公司的10%就是1000亿美元，标题虽然吓人，这种波动其实很正常。
sentences.en: 10% of a trillion-dollar company is 100 billion dollars; the headlines may be scary, but this kind of swing is actually quite normal.

sentences.zh: 看涨期权，以及他为什么没能下单
sentences.en: Call options, and why he couldn't place the order

sentences.zh: 风险更高的玩法，是在下跌时买入看涨期权，价格回升后卖出，最迟周二早上就得走人，否则就像拿自己的钱玩俄罗斯轮盘赌。
sentences.en: The riskier play is to buy call options on the dip and sell once the price recovers, getting out by Tuesday morning at the latest; otherwise it's like playing Russian roulette with your own money.

sentences.zh: 问题在于，劳斯莱斯没有在多伦多证券交易所上市。
sentences.en: The problem is that Rolls-Royce isn't listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange.

sentences.zh: 在美国，它通过场外交易的粉单市场交易：RYCEF、RYCEY和RLLCF。
sentences.en: In the US, it trades over the counter on the pink sheets: RYCEF, RYCEY and RLLCF.

sentences.zh: Questrade不让他下这单，盈透证券或许可以。
sentences.en: Questrade won't let him place this order, but Interactive Brokers might.

sentences.zh: 股票表与十二月反弹
sentences.en: The stock sheet and the December rebound

sentences.zh: 他已把劳斯莱斯加进股票表，按周五的1164回溯记录。
sentences.en: He has added Rolls-Royce to the stock sheet, recording it retroactively at Friday's 1164.

sentences.zh: 十二月中旬，人们为了抵扣税务亏损而抛售；随后出现超卖的快速反弹，被称为“华尔街唯一的免费午餐”；再往后是圣诞老人行情。
sentences.en: In mid-December, people sell to offset tax losses; then comes a sharp rebound from oversold levels, called "the only free lunch on Wall Street"; after that comes the Santa Claus rally.

sentences.zh: 硬盘与盖蒂法则
sentences.en: Hard Drives and Getty's Rule

sentences.zh: 半开玩笑地说：他现在花在AI上的时间，和当年花在股市上的一样多，而他还需要一份工作。
sentences.en: Half-jokingly, he says he now spends as much time on AI as he once spent on the stock market, and he still needs a job.

sentences.zh: 整个周末，他都在六块硬盘之间倒腾文件，不禁自问：“哪个侄子侄女会愿意翻我的硬盘，看几小时的史蒂夫叔叔自言自语？”
sentences.en: All weekend he shuffled files between six hard drives and couldn't help asking himself: "Which of my nephews or nieces would ever want to dig through my hard drives and watch hours of Uncle Steve talking to himself?"

sentences.zh: 多年来，他的公寓里一直挂着盖蒂《如何致富》里的一句话：“永远别忘了企业的核心目标：以更低的成本，为更多的人生产更多更好的产品，或提供更多更好的服务。”
sentences.en: For years, a line from Getty's How to Be Rich has hung in his apartment: "Never forget the central aim of business: to produce more and better goods, or provide more and better services, for more people at ever lower cost."

sentences.zh: 今天，这句话又一次击中了他。
sentences.en: Today, those words struck him once again.

sentences.zh: 那么，他自己在生产什么？
sentences.en: So what is he himself producing?

sentences.zh: 他的新视频控制面板
sentences.en: His new video control panel

sentences.zh: 盖蒂这条原则，正好描述了Anthropic、OpenAI和谷歌在做的事。
sentences.en: Getty's principle describes exactly what Anthropic, OpenAI and Google are doing.

sentences.zh: 受亚当·柯里“凭感觉写代码”的启发，史蒂文搭了一个在浏览器里运行、基于文字稿的视频编辑器。
sentences.en: Inspired by Adam Curry's "vibe coding," Steven built a transcript-based video editor that runs in the browser.

sentences.zh: AI生成片段、B-roll和图表的速度，比他审核还快。
sentences.en: AI generates clips, B-roll and charts faster than he can review them.

sentences.zh: 他边看边用快捷键标记缩放、B-roll和标题卡，剩下的交给电脑。
sentences.en: While watching, he uses keyboard shortcuts to mark zooms, B-roll and title cards, and leaves the rest to the computer.

sentences.zh: 去年他花了3000元买DaVinci，只打开过一次。
sentences.en: Last year he spent 3,000 yuan on DaVinci and opened it only once.

sentences.zh: “它依然复杂得要命。”
sentences.en: "It's still insanely complicated."

sentences.zh: 一档播客，多个“品牌”
sentences.en: One podcast, many "brands"

sentences.zh: 加里·维纳查克说，他每天发布约400条内容。
sentences.en: Gary Vaynerchuk says he publishes about 400 pieces of content every day.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文的AI流程现在能把每期节目变成漫画、梗图和短视频，供四五个品牌使用，其中三个是英语教学频道。
sentences.en: Steven's AI pipeline can now turn each episode into comics, memes and short videos for four or five brands, three of which are English-teaching channels.

sentences.zh: 每个品牌都有一份CSV文件，可批量上传。
sentences.en: Each brand has its own CSV file that can be bulk-uploaded.

sentences.zh: 课程、书籍和学习小组也即将推出。
sentences.en: Courses, books and study groups are also coming soon.

sentences.zh: 他还要把吉祥物史蒂文老师请回来，因为连他自己都看腻了自己的脸。
sentences.en: He's also bringing back his mascot, Teacher Steven, because even he is sick of seeing his own face.

sentences.zh: ⏳ 一年倒计时
sentences.en: ⏳ A one-year countdown

sentences.zh: AI估算，他的英语教学文件夹里至少有一年的内容。
sentences.en: The AI estimated that his English-teaching folder holds at least a year's worth of content.

sentences.zh: “如果现在做不成，那我永远也做不成。”
sentences.en: "If I can't make it happen now, I never will."

sentences.zh: 倒计时从第一个账号上线那天开始。
sentences.en: The countdown starts the day the first account goes live.

sentences.zh: 如果一年后赚不到像样的钱，他就得面对现实，包括这档播客可能也要结束。
sentences.en: If he isn't making decent money after a year, he'll have to face reality, which could include this podcast ending too.

sentences.zh: 正如阿里·G所说：“你怎能和现实争辩？”
sentences.en: As Ali G said: "How can you argue with reality?"

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's Summary

sentences.zh: 保持健身器械干净，对超卖的股票多留个心眼，并不断问自己：我是否在以更低的成本，为更多人提供更多更好的价值？
sentences.en: Keep the gym equipment clean, be extra careful with oversold stocks, and keep asking yourself: am I providing more and better value to more people at a lower cost?

sentences.zh: 这就是他给未来一年定的考题。
sentences.en: This is the test question he has set for himself for the coming year.
